summary: Add gh plate pr verify and plate_pr_verify MCP tool (#1365): scripted read-only pre-merge checks (base main, labels, Feature fragment, milestone, closing keyword, base sync, required CI with cancelled-run dedupe, review threads). Optional local unittest discover with stale-base count warning.
migration_impact: Additive CLI subcommand and MCP tool in the default review profile. No merge or mutation behavior.
migration_guidance: 1. Agents run gh plate pr verify <N> --json before requesting human merge.
2. Optional gh plate pr verify <N> --run-tests to confirm unittest count on current main.
3. MCP hosts use plate_pr_verify with pr_number (and optional run_tests).
agent_notes: Report-only; never merge from pr verify. Wrong-base PRs fail the base_branch check.
